profile.name: Alexander Mitchell
profile.tagline: Crafting scalable systems & intelligent solutions that drive real-world impact.
profile.bio: I'm a Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience building high-performance applications across the full stack. I specialize in designing scalable distributed systems, integrating AI and machine learning pipelines, and architecting cloud-native solutions on AWS and GCP. I'm passionate about writing clean, maintainable code and mentoring engineering teams to deliver products that make a difference. When I'm not coding, you'll find me contributing to open-source projects or exploring the latest in generative AI.

experience.summary: Leading the development of an enterprise AI platform that serves 200+ clients. Architecting microservices, building LLM-powered features, and mentoring a team of 6 engineers.
highlights: Designed and shipped a RAG-based document intelligence system processing 10M+ documents monthly
Reduced API latency by 40% through query optimization and intelligent caching layers
Led migration from monolith to microservices architecture, improving deployment frequency by 5x
Mentored 6 junior engineers, establishing code review practices and technical documentation standards

experience.summary: Built core infrastructure for a cloud-native analytics platform used by Fortune 500 companies. Focused on real-time data pipelines and dashboard systems.
highlights: Built real-time analytics pipeline processing 50K events/second using Kafka and Flink
Developed interactive dashboard framework adopted by 150+ enterprise customers
Implemented multi-tenant architecture reducing infrastructure costs by 35%
Created automated load testing framework that caught 90% of performance regressions pre-deploy

experience.summary: Full-stack development on a data visualization platform. Shipped features across React frontends and Python backends serving 50K+ monthly active users.
highlights: Shipped a drag-and-drop visualization builder increasing user engagement by 60%
Optimized PostgreSQL queries reducing report generation time from 30s to 2s
Built RESTful API layer serving 10M+ requests daily with 99.9% uptime
Introduced TypeScript across the frontend codebase, reducing production bugs by 45%

experience.summary: Started my career building web applications for small businesses. Gained deep experience in React, Node.js, and agile development practices.
highlights: Delivered 12+ client projects on time and within budget as the lead frontend developer
Built a component library that reduced development time by 30% across projects
Implemented CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions, automating testing and deployment

projects.title: NeuralQuery
projects.subtitle: AI-Powered Code Search Engine
projects.description: A semantic code search engine that uses transformer models to understand natural language queries and find relevant code across large repositories. Features include multi-language support, context-aware ranking, and real-time indexing.

projects.title: CloudMesh
projects.subtitle: Multi-Cloud Infrastructure Manager
projects.description: A unified dashboard for managing infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and Azure. Provides cost optimization recommendations, security auditing, and automated scaling policies through an intuitive interface.

projects.title: SynthWave Studio
projects.subtitle: Browser-Based Music Production
projects.description: A web-based digital audio workstation featuring a synthesizer engine, real-time audio processing, and collaborative editing. Built with Web Audio API and WebAssembly for near-native performance.

projects.title: DataCanvas
projects.subtitle: Interactive Data Visualization Framework
projects.description: An open-source library for creating beautiful, interactive data visualizations with minimal code. Supports 20+ chart types, real-time data streaming, and export to multiple formats.

projects.title: SecureVault
projects.subtitle: Zero-Knowledge Password Manager
projects.description: An end-to-end encrypted password manager with zero-knowledge architecture. Features include biometric authentication, secure sharing, and breach monitoring with automatic credential rotation.

projects.title: EventFlow
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Event Processing Pipeline
projects.description: A high-throughput event processing system capable of handling 100K+ events per second with exactly-once delivery guarantees. Includes a visual pipeline builder and comprehensive monitoring dashboard.
